messages:
Alex R.: Heads-up — seeing a spike in 413s on /v1/embeddings when clients send mixed-dimension arrays (e.g., some items 768, some 1536) in a single payload. Likely splitter + routing mismatch :eyes:
Priya S.: Saw this in SLO alerts last night. Partner-integrations traffic. 413s + occasional 500s when shard assignment times out.
Tom W.: Quick q — is this one request with different vector dims in the same array, or multiple items each with their own dims?
Alex R.: Example (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input": [[...768...],[...1536...]], "model":"rwd-embed-mix"}'
# responds 413 {"error":"payload dims inconsistent"}
```
Maya L.: We're currently rejecting at the inbound validator because downstream splitters assume uniform dim per-request. Options: a) auto-split at edge by dim (adds subrequests & quota complexity) b) return richer error with hints + docs link c) build hybrid backend that accepts mixed dims (expensive).
Jonah K.: We don't tag telemetry for "mixed_dims" today. Can we emit a boolean tag and a histogram of items-per-request so dashboards/alerts can slice this?
Priya S.: +1. Also request a 1% sample of full payloads (PII/redacted) for the infra team to inspect patterns — privacy team said sampled bodies OK if redacted. Need per-customer counts too so we can see quota impact.
Tom W.: Important: if we auto-split we will double/tri-count token usage across subrequests. We must either bill the parent request or expose an explicit header like `X-Embeds-Split-Count` so customers aren't surprised.
Alex R.: Proposal: short-term: return 413 with actionable error + docs link; emit telemetry tag; add console alert for mixed-dim requests. Medium-term: edge splitter that can rewrite into uniform-subrequests and return `X-Embeds-Split: N`. Add opt-in `?auto_split=true` for canary.
Maya L.: I'll prototype an edge splitter that rewrites into multiple uniform-dim subrequests and aggregates responses. Will only run if `auto_split=true` to start. Need quota-api change to attribute subrequests properly.
Jonah K.: I'll add `embeddings.payload.mixed_dims` metric and a dashboard tile under Embeddings -> Payloads. Also add trace span `splitter.rewrite` so we can measure added latency. Alerts: fire when mixed-dims > 0.5% per-customer or error rate > 0.2%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: splitter-proxy v0.3 -> dev at 1887654360
Priya S.: Who will own the console UI to surface `split_count` and the opt-in toggle? cc Maya L.
Maya L.: I'll own the UI change. ETA: prototype backend in 1 sprint, console + quota/invoice changes in 2 sprints. I'll open GH PRs and a short design doc today.
Tom W.: I'll draft the quota attribution design — options: parent-bill (preferred for UX) or per-subrequest billing with explicit header so customers can opt-in.
Alex R.: Great. Action items: Maya prototype + PR, Jonah dashboard + metric, Tom quota design doc, Priya coordinate privacy sampling. I'll write a short RFC and link docs. Thanks everyone :tada:
